versions.summary: Upgraded index architecture to FlatBuffer columnar format, increasing read/write throughput to 442 MB/s and resolving memory leaks during multi-part archive processing.

breaking.change: Changed index structure from v2 B-Tree to v3 FlatBuffer Columnar (.apx extension changed to .apx3); legacy index files cannot be loaded directly.
breaking.migration: Run aperture-cli migrate --input ./index.apx --output ./index.apx3 to convert index files. Migration of 1,000,000 records takes 2 min 37 sec.

features: Refactored underlying I/O module, increasing throughput by 42.8% from 310 MB/s to 442 MB/s.
Added block-level CRC64 integrity verification, achieving verification speeds of 1.2 GB/s.
Added multi-part archive progress logging, outputting real-time processed bytes and estimated remaining time.
fixes: Fixed a memory leak caused by unreleased temporary buffer space during 64 GB multi-part archive operations.
Fixed index parsing failures occurring when file paths contained special control characters.

versions.summary: Added Zstd compression layer and multi-threaded archiving support, optimizing small-file packaging efficiency.
features: Integrated Zstd compression algorithm, improving compression ratio by 18.5%.
Added multi-threaded parallel packaging mechanism, supporting up to 32 concurrent tasks.
fixes: Fixed directory enumeration timeout issues when a single directory exceeds 100,000 files.

versions.summary: Initial release of Aperture Offline Archiving System with v2 B-Tree indexing and multi-part packaging.
features: Implemented v2 B-Tree index structure for fast file retrieval.
Implemented AES-256-GCM encryption for offline archives.
fixes: Fixed log writing race conditions under high concurrent load.
